semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides specialized carrier boards and buffer pads for PCB applications, which are crucial in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Guangdong Shuocheng Technology Co., LTD specializes in developing carrier boards and reusable buffer pads for PCB applications in the semiconductor industry. Their products focus on cost reduction, space management, and improving cleanroom cleanliness, with applications in electronics and CCL lamination.
capabilities: Carrier boards for servers and high-frequency transmission
Reusable buffer pads with lifespan monitoring
Solutions for adhesive insufficiency and high copper thickness
